title: Angular Corners
description: A resource pack with sharp corners and a clean GUI.
body:
# Angular Corners

Angular Corners is a resource pack that replaces rounded UI corners with more angular ones and make the UI a cleaner style.

The goal of this pack is to adjust the visual style of the UI so that it feels less rounded and feels cleaner, while keeping the overall UI consistent with the vanilla layout.

## Features

- Replaced rounded corners with sharp ones
- Maybe compatible with other resource packs, because this pack only modifies UI and ascii-font

## PS

This resource pack originates from a project I made back in 2020 with the same name, which was never released. A small tribute to my past self from six years ago.

## 中文版介绍

**Angular Corners** 资源包将原版圆润的边角变成了更锋利的样子，还让 UI 变得更清爽。

这个资源包旨在调整 UI 的视觉效果使其更不那么圆滑且更干净，但也保留了原版的视觉效果。

### 特点

- 把圆角替换了
- 大概是和其他资源包兼容的，因为这个资源包只更改了 UI 和 ASCII 字体

### PS

这个资源包源自于 2020 年我制作的一个同名项目，当时并没发布。算是对六年前自己的一个小小致敬。
